Hi Grace —

Thanks again for last week's demo. MegaCorp is ready to start the hands-on portion of the POC. Our ops and SRE leads want to run a mix of prompt walkthroughs, routing tests, and one focused load drill to validate throughput at peak. Can we get a set of rotating time blocks that cover US morning, EU afternoon, and an APAC friendly slot so our global on-call can join at least one?

- 3 x 2-hour hands-on blocks (prompt review, routing tuning, KV/cache checks)
- 1 x 1.5-hour load drill (scripted traffic, monitoring live)
- Pre-read agenda + brief sync to walk through the plan before the sessions

Are you able to propose a few timeblock options next week (Nov 16–20)? We prefer windows that rotate so our CS and infra teams can watch at least one session in their local day.

Thanks,

Appreciate the clear list. We can absolutely run the mix of prompt work, routing checks, and a load drill. I pulled together a draft agenda and a simple timezone grid (attached). Before we lock anything, a couple quick clarifying questions:

- For the load drill, do you want steady-state sustained load (X rps) or bursty peak patterns (short bursts to RPS)? If you have a target QPS per replica that helps us size earlier.
- Which metrics dashboards should be annotated for the drill? Our default is token/sec, latency P95/P99, GPU util; if you need any app-level metrics, share the Grafana link.

Proposed rotating blocks (all durations in local time):
1) US morning / EU late afternoon / APAC late evening — Mon 16 & Tue 17: 09:00–11:00 PT (rotates to EU 17:00–19:00)
2) EU-friendly mid-day / US early morning — Wed 18: 13:00–15:00 CET (rotates to US 04:00–06:00 PT)
3) APAC window — Thu 19: 18:00–20:00 SGT (rotates to US 03:00–05:00 PT)

I realize those are broad; Dev will draft concrete UTC blocks and a single 1.5-hour slot for the load drill. If those sound reasonable we can lock and send calendar invites.

Cheers,
Grace

Redwood Inference
